parts: [shouting] FUCK! [annoyed] A bird keeps shitting on me while I'm walking.

parts.t: [annoyed] And it's starting to piss me the fuck off.

parts: [relieved] So I go inside my house. [disbelief] But it's in my house now. [angry] Still. Fucking. Shitting on me.
[deadpan] He doesn't give a flying fuck.

parts.t: [frustrated] My wife is screaming at me... [embarrassed] mostly because I haven't made love to her in three months. [shouting] But I'm covered head to toe in bird shit!

parts: [determined] So I dig an underground bunker. [taunting] Try to get in here, motherfucker.
[nervous] The bird finds me... [disgusted] and shits directly into my mouth.
[sneaky] So I sneak laxatives in his food. [smug] That'll teach that bastard a lesson.
[curious] But wait... [nervous] it's about to fucking explode. [tense] It's holding... and holding...
[shouting] BOOM! [disgusted] Bird shit all over me. [deadpan] I look like a fucking porta potty.
[amazed] The ass blast sends the bird all the way to my wife... [laughing] and now he's shitting on HER.
[relieved] He isn't shitting on me anymore, so that's great. [excited] Sweet!
